Description: This will be the temporary leasing office for a new affordable housing project in Berkeley, Maudelle Miller Shirek. Maudelle Miller Shirek Community is being built at 2001 Ashby and will open in June 2024. The leasing office will operate between February and June of 2024 to process applications to live at Maudelle. It will be occupied by employees of The John Stewart Company, the property management company for Maudelle.
